---
title: "Past Sessions"
description: |
  Find slides and other information from past sessions
output: distill::distill_article
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r embed-xaringan-2022, echo=FALSE}
xaringanExtra::embed_xaringan(url = "slides/slides.html", ratio = "16:9")
```

<aside>
Shortcut Keys

- `f`: full-screen
- `Esc`: exit full-screen
- `o`: tile view
- `r ji('left_arrow')` `r ji('right_arrow')`: advance slide
</aside>
